notes: Every category is crossed with every target persona (24 x 5 units per liar model per replicate).

Placebo persona per target: the placebo note describes a different pool persona whose cues are disjoint from the target's (all 16 cues, not only scorable ones), so every scorable target cue stays placebo-net. P5's only disjoint pool persona is P6, which fixes the cycle P1->P2->P3->P1, P5<->P6.
Length matching: for each target, the full, reversed and placebo notes are all padded with the frozen neutral filler sentences to the longest of the three unpadded notes.
